rawContent:
Tweet by @AndreaPN (AndreaPN)
Author bio: Founder 404AI Labs
Text: I see a lot of people criticizing @0xDeployer for building a new launchpad and launching a new token on @RobinhoodCrypto chain. 

I'm also a builder, and 404AI Labs also has multiple products and tokens. imo, it's both a good move and a bad move.

Good move:
@pools_dot_fun is well positioned to compete head to head with Pons, Noxa, and most recently PoolsTrade.

History shows trenches always favor native projects. @virtuals_io or @bankrbot had strong market share on Base, but when they moved to Solana they couldn't take it because Solana trenches always favor native products. Clanker at its peak on Base also failed to win market share from Monad's native launchpads after crossing chains.

Poolsfun, a pure meme launchpad with a buy & burn mechanism, fits Robinhood's culture better, which favors pure memes and a trench community with strong meme volume. Bankr will stay focused on utility products, AI agent products built for the long term that need real infrastructure like the LLM gateway.

Also, 0xDeployer has a huge fame and can bring real traffic to projects launched on Poolsfun, giving it enough power to compete with other launchpads.

So creating a new protocol with a new native token makes more sense and gives a real edge in the launchpad war.

Bad move:
0xDeployer's name has been tied to Bankr for 2 years now, so him shipping a new product will definitely shake the Bankr ecosystem. Trenches that backed him and held base:0x22af33fe49fd1fa80c7149773dde5890d3c76f3b from day one may feel betrayed. 

But from a product view, Bankr is still a strong product: deep liquidity, listed on major US exchanges, solid ecosystem, big community, and low mc. It still has plenty of room to run.

In conclusion:
Nobody knows if Poolsfun will win or lose, but I say just keep building. 

Robinhood chain is still very promising, and the launchpad, RWA, and paired stocks pie is big enough for teams with real strength to join in.
